name: Two-year operational spares
description: Two-year operational spares for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Commissioning. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ spare parts packages (EX — standardised spare parts packages
specifications.basis: MAN 'Prepare for MAN 175D' printed June 2022: post-commissioning, mechanical, after-treatment and automation packages; reconditioned exchange components include cylinder heads, turbochargers, fuel injectors and cooling water pumps, remanufactured at Frederikshavn, Denmark. These are MAN parts and are expressly excluded by the BOQ wording.

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ spare parts packages (EX — high-demand OEM spare parts delivery target
specifications.basis: MAN brochure printed June 2022: 'Prompt delivery of high-demand OEM spare parts within 24 hours'; Singapore and Denmark stock referenced in MAN 'Essential spare parts' material - out-of-scope MAN parts, included only as market context.

specifications.metric: GE contractual service agreement (long — CSA duration at Kimanis Power plant
specifications.basis: GE press release 14 June 2011: GE signed a contractual service agreement with Kimanis Power Sdn Bhd to support the 300 MW plant for 18 years; CSAs described as providing predictable maintenance costs and high availability.

specifications.metric: Wärtsilä Malaysia Sdn Bhd local servic — professionals in Malaysia
specifications.basis: Wartsila.com/mys read 25 Nov 2026: established 1996 in Kuala Lumpur; over 15 professionals in Kuala Lumpur and Pasir Gudang, Johor.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D standardised spare parts  — number of standardised spare parts packages
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', printed June 2022, p.6: 'For the MAN 175D you can select four standardized spare parts packages' - post-commissioning, mechanical, after-treatment and automation packages.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D standardised spare parts  — prompt delivery target for high-demand OEM spare parts
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.15: 'Prompt delivery of high-demand OEM spare parts within 24 hours'; same page notes a network of over 100 service centres worldwide and 24/7 service.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D standardised spare parts  — local stock of consumable parts
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.2: 'Local stocks of consumable parts can be provided upon request'; original spare parts supplied from main stock and warehouse facilities in Denmark.

specifications.metric: Reconditioned exchange components — components offered as reconditioned units on exchange basis
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.8: 'Components offered as reconditioned units on exchange basis are cylinder heads, turbochargers, fuel injectors and cooling water pumps'; re-manufactured at the MAN 175D production centre in Frederikshavn, Denmark, with the same warranty terms and quality as new units at lower cost.

gaps.why: No published 2-year operational spares list, quantity or price for non-MAN equipment for this plant was found. MAN's printed packages are expressly excluded by the BOQ wording.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the bidder's 2-year spares schedule with part numbers and prices, and keep MAN items out of this line item.

gaps.why: No two-year operating-spares list, quantity, unit price or awarded spares contract for a 7-unit gas engine generator plant was found. MAN PrimeServ's June 2022 brochure prints four standardised packages, a 24-hour delivery target and reconditioned exchange components, but no two-year scope or price,
gaps.next_action: Obtain a priced two-year spares schedule from the bidder/OEM; do not treat the four generic MAN packages as the project's two-year spares.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
